recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-16414 unless a future work-group decision opens a broader profile/profiling terminology policy change.
issue_request: FHIR-16414 was Published with resolution Not Persuasive with Modification for STU3. It asked FHIR to avoid confusing broad use of "profile" and "profiling" and resolved to define Profile in the profiling-page glossary as a set of constraints on a resource represented by a StructureDefinition constraint, with a note that the verb profile/profiling means creating a profile.
initial_application: Jira comments record svn revision 14217. Git commit dc4b3b45af364e809532fc1224c3669388c17c5f, "GF#16414 - fix definition of profile", added the Profile glossary row and verb note to source/profiling.html and removed the prior sentence treating "profile" as a general package/item term.
additional_context: The current profiling page still has the glossary row and note, but the row now says derivation = constraint because later FHIR-25043 history updated the wording from the older kind = constraint model to the current StructureDefinition.derivation model. The profiling page is active under source/hierarchy.xml, and StructureDefinition and ImplementationGuide are active resources in source/fhir.ini. Searches of the related conformance/profile pages found no surviving old ambiguous sentence, and quoted Zulip/Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: No source file was changed. The current build source already conveys the FHIR-16414 clarification in the active profiling page, and surrounding conformance/profile pages use profile/profiling in context rather than reintroducing the broad package/item definition.

related_jiras.note: Later source history changed the FHIR-16414 glossary row from kind = constraint to derivation = constraint so it matches the current StructureDefinition model.
